Tide constituents

Download tide constituent files used to create tide predictions.

Constituent files are available to download for tide sites that have at least 3 years of data.

Major ports are updated annually when we analyse data from ongoing sea-level recorders from the previous calendar year. Other locations are normally updated every 3 years.

Disclaimer

LINZ’s constituents are created using in-house software and applications. Open-source tide packages exist, but LINZ cannot advise on these. Constituents are provided for information only with no troubleshooting support.

LINZ accepts no liability for any direct, indirect, consequential or incidental damages that result from any errors in the information, whether due to LINZ or a third party, or that arise from the use, or misuse, of the information available from this site.
